finalText:
It builds clean now, exit code 0.

Two real bugs were hiding under all that deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing shapes on you:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That's `undefined.toFixed(0)` — a crash.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` only accepted `true` or `false` for the backoff flag. The new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset, so it was throwing instead of just treating that as off.

Fixed both: `resolveRetries` now reads `retryCount`, and `isBackoffEnabled` treats `undefined` the same as `false`. The rest of the warnings (`DEP0142`, `Buffer()`, punycode, etc.) are just deprecation noise from the bump — nothing else to chase there.
